ai_review.summary: Nice‑sounding recording of a fan‑favorite night featuring killer Scarlet Begonias, Fire on the Mountain and Jerry’s soaring guitar work.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this show five stars, calling it one of their favorites and praising the “nice sounding” audio. Highlights include a powerful Lost Sailor segue into a killer Scarlet Begonias and an inspired Fire on the Mountain where Jerry Garcia “kicks ass”. No technical complaints are noted, suggesting the recording is clean enough for download.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic 5‑star review emphasizes strong performance and pleasant sound; limited data leads to low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the audio as ‘nice sounding’ with no specific issues such as muddiness or drop‑outs.
